description.purpose: The screen's own clock. It carries no schedule of its own: the compose cell orders exactly one one-shot schedule, named `due`, for the earliest moment at which -- if nothing else happens -- a window's score crosses a rung, a leaving window's frame is over, a `relevant_until` or a `ttl_ms` runs out. Each pass replaces the previous order; a screen with nothing due orders nothing.
description.use_when: Always, as part of `display@2.3.2`. It is not a poll (GH #553): every strike has a name and a time, and a screen on which nothing can change stays silent.
description.not_in_scope: No cron, no recurring schedule, no content: the strike carries an empty body, and what it MEANS is the `in_tick` lane the hive's edge stamps on it.
